summary.whatChanges: Flips the pnpm workspace `allowBuilds` entry for esbuild from `false` to `true`, so esbuild's install/build lifecycle script is now permitted to run during dependency installation instead of being blocked.
behaviorChanges: `pnpm install` now executes esbuild's postinstall build script instead of skipping it
esbuild's native binary is fetched/installed at install time, so tools depending on it can run without the previously ignored-build warning
risks: Allowing a package lifecycle script to run executes third-party code during install, a supply-chain surface that was previously blocked
Install time and CI behavior may change if esbuild's script downloads a platform-specific binary in restricted/offline environments
